summary: Blocker — migrations/20260722_group_section_access.sql adds CHECK (access_scope IN (0,1)) without converting or rejecting legacy access_scope=2 rows. Since the predecessor model validly allowed 0/1/2, the migration fails on a valid populated database, preventing deployment. A migration-safe, explicitly approved mapping is required before adding the constraint. Blocker — src/services/binderService.js:206-216 performs master transfer without SELECT FOR UPDATE revalidation. Two concurrent transfers can both observe the same master, promote different targets, and leave multiple role=0 members. This violates the packet’s atomic role-mutation AC; reuse getMembersForUpdate to lock actor and target(s) and revalidate within the transaction. No product files were modified.
